title: The Great Penguin Rush
description: Gentoo penguins (Pygoscelis papua) dive into Antarctica’s Port Charcot. The species is the fastest underwater-swimming bird on Earth, reaching speeds of up to 22 miles per hour. Photographer Romain Barats captured this raft while snorkeling as the penguins headed out to fish and feed on krill.
translated_description: 巴布亚企鹅（学名：Pygoscelis papua）跃入南极洲的沙尔科港。该物种是地球上水下游泳最快的鸟类，速度可达每小时22英里。摄影师罗曼·巴拉茨在浮潜时拍下了这群企鹅，当时它们正出发去捕鱼和觅食磷虾。
